headline: Data-center revenue surges while losses persist
summary_short: Applied Digital's shard-tracked diluted EPS for this event was -$0.39, a loss that widened 8.3% q/q and 62.5% y/y.
summary_long: The fetched primary for this event is Applied Digital's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026 — full fiscal-year revenue rose to $611.3M from $228.6M in FY2025, driven by the Polaris Forge 1 HPC data-center leasing ramp (one hyperscale customer was 59% of revenue). The Cloud Services business was divested to Ekso Bionics in May 2026. Full-year net loss attributable to common stockholders was $250.3M vs $233.7M in FY2025; capex totaled roughly $2.9B on data-center construction. Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.11 for the fiscal year. No revenue or EPS guidance for a future period was stated in the filing.
